description: Fallback models and effort levels per agent CLI, used only where the installed CLI and its local configuration expose nothing. Every entry is marked source=fallback in the probe; a local override in .runtime/hosts/<host>/agent-models.local.json adds entries. roles.light is the default light model of one-shot read-only analyses (directive proposals, task analysis); a null model means the CLI default, and the local override replaces a role per provider.

gemini.source: Gemini CLI 0.68.0 installed: gemini --list-models and the model constants of its bundle; not checked against ai.google.dev (web access denied in the session)
